# Server Rules These are the rules for Final Horizon '84.
This server does not fit into traditional ss14 roleplay labels but a level of roleplay is expected, those who are familiar with games such as arma 3 or escalation13 may be familiar with this style of military roleplay.
You are expected to understand these rules as ignorance is not a valid reason to break them.
- [textlink="1. Listen to admins and leadership" link="FHRule1"] - [textlink="2. No bigotry or slurs" link="FHRule2"] - [textlink="3. Do not metacomm or cheat" link="FHRule3"] - [textlink="4. Hold yourself and others to a standard fit for your position" link="FHRule4"] - [textlink="5. Do not use netspeek or unrealistic language" link="FHRule5"] - [textlink="6. Use a realistic character" link="FHRule6"] - [textlink="7. Do not grief your team or base" link="FHRule7"]
